diff --git a/django/forms/widgets.py b/django/forms/widgets.py
index 02aa32b20..5e41b4eca 100644
--- a/django/forms/widgets.py
+++ b/django/forms/widgets.py
@@ -59,9 +59,14 @@ class Media:
 
     @property
     def _css(self):
-        css = self._css_lists[0]
-        # filter(None, ...) avoids calling merge with empty dicts.
-        for obj in filter(None, self._css_lists[1:]):
+        sorted_lists = sorted(
+            filter(None, self._css_lists),
+            key=lambda d: -sum(len(v) for v in d.values()),
+        )
+        if not sorted_lists:
+            return {}
+        css = sorted_lists[0]
+        for obj in sorted_lists[1:]:
             css = {
                 medium: self.merge(css.get(medium, []), obj.get(medium, []))
                 for medium in css.keys() | obj.keys()
@@ -70,9 +75,14 @@ class Media:
 
     @property
     def _js(self):
-        js = self._js_lists[0]
-        # filter(None, ...) avoids calling merge() with empty lists.
-        for obj in filter(None, self._js_lists[1:]):
+        sorted_lists = sorted(
+            filter(None, self._js_lists),
+            key=lambda lst: -len(lst),
+        )
+        if not sorted_lists:
+            return []
+        js = sorted_lists[0]
+        for obj in sorted_lists[1:]:
             js = self.merge(js, obj)
         return js

     def test_merge_css_three_way(self):
         widget1 = Media(css={'screen': ['a.css']})
@@ -571,3 +571,16 @@ class FormsMediaTestCase(SimpleTestCase):
         # was never specified.
         merged = widget3 + form1 + form2
         self.assertEqual(merged._css, {'screen': ['a.css', 'b.css'], 'all': ['c.css']})
+
+    def test_merge_js_three_way_no_conflict(self):
+        """
+        Merging 3 or more media objects with overlapping but non-conflicting
+        dependencies should not raise MediaOrderConflictWarning.
+        """
+        widget1 = Media(js=['color-picker.js'])
+        widget2 = Media(js=['text-editor.js'])
+        widget3 = Media(js=['text-editor.js', 'text-editor-extras.js', 'color-picker.js'])
+
+        merged = widget1 + widget2 + widget3
+
+        self.assertEqual(merged._js, ['text-editor.js', 'text-editor-extras.js', 'color-picker.js'])
